title: Audit record: admin intent signatures and retention classification
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Implement a companion 'intent signature' and retention classification for admin-oriented audit events. Purpose: provide a concise human-readable summary of admin intent, canonicalized machine tags for automated classification, and a retention class to drive lifecycle/redaction. This ticket defines schema additions, how the semantic delta and canonical diff interact, and a migration strategy for existing events.
diff_encoding_strategy: Use compact semantic delta where we combine path-oriented ops with normalized field fingerprints. For large blobs use content-hash references and store full object snapshots only when diff size exceeds threshold. Ensure diffs are deterministic and canonicalized (sorted keys, stable ids and normalized timestamps) to allow dedup and compact storage. Preserve a human-readable patch for UI rendering alongside the compact binary encoding.
retention_classification_rules: policy flag flips in feature experiments => retention_class=standard
SSO login and logout events => retention_class=standard
privacy_redaction_strategy: Apply layered redaction: 1) Field-level redaction based on redaction_hint; 2) Actor display names replaced with display_hash for longterm retention; 3) For compliance exports provide full fidelity only after an explicit export authorization and tagging. Redaction rules are parametric by retention_class and can be overridden for legal holds.
rollout_plan: 1) Design review with Sec/Privacy and Platform (1 week)
2) Small-scale producer change for admin endpoints (canary 5% of events)
3) Store intent_signature in parallel stream for 2 weeks and compare recall/precision to manual annotations
4) Enable retention-class based lifecycle in object storage with test policy enforcement
5) Backfill/migrate historical events using batch enrichers (staged by age)
6) Full production roll and expose filters in Console and telemetry
acceptance_criteria: Schema additions accepted by Security and Legal
Audit events include intent_signature and retention_class for admin actions as defined
Diffs meet size and determinism targets in load test (p95 encode < 5ms)
Retention policy lifecycle enforces deletion/archival per class in staging
Console search can filter by intent_tags and retention_class
Redaction behavior validated with Privacy team and test exports
